# Gavelling

Gavelling is a web platform for the global Model UN (MUN) community: a conference discovery and management layer (find, apply to, and organise MUN conferences) plus real-time committee session software used by chairs, delegates, and faculty advisors worldwide.

## What Gavelling Does

Gavelling Conferences (live since July 2026) is the conference layer: a public directory where delegates find and apply to real MUN conferences worldwide (browse by country, date, fee, and level, or on a world map), plus end-to-end management for organisers — delegate applications, smart country-role allocations, delegation management for schools and societies, study guide distribution, position paper review, payments and financial aid, chair and staff recruitment, awards, and a shareable MUN CV that records each delegate's conferences and awards.

Gavelling Sessions manages real-time MUN committee sessions: roll call with quorum tracking, General Speakers List (GSL) with timer, Moderated Caucus, Unmoderated Caucus, motions, voting, live delegate chat, and resolution document viewing.

## Who Uses It

MUN delegates looking for their next conference; organisers and secretariats running conferences; chairs, co-chairs, and faculty advisors running committee sessions — at high school and university level, active in 18+ countries.

## Key MUN Terms (for context)

- GSL: General Speakers List — primary debate mechanism in MUN
- TdT: Temps des tours — French MUN equivalent of GSL
- Mod caucus: Moderated Caucus — structured debate with per-speaker time limits
- Unmod caucus: Unmoderated Caucus — informal negotiation period
- RTR: Right to Reply — delegate's right to respond to a personal attack
- P+V: Present and Voting — stronger attendance commitment than "Present"; delegate cannot abstain
- Quorum: Minimum number of delegates required to conduct official business
- Working papers / Draft resolutions: Collaborative delegate documents proposed for committee adoption
- Operative / Preambulatory clauses: Two sections of a MUN resolution
- MUN CV: A delegate's verified record of conferences attended, roles held, and awards won

## Pricing

Free to use. Listing a conference is free for organisers. No account required for delegates joining a live committee session.

## Technology

Web app built with Next.js and Supabase. Works on any modern browser on desktop, tablet, or mobile — no installation required.

## About

Built by Peter Zakhar and Christian, both experienced MUN practitioners. Launched 2025. Headquartered in Europe.
